name: Wardstone Lattice
text: When you assign hits to your units during combat in a system that contains 1 or more of your structures, you may exhaust this card to cancel 1 hit for each adjacent system that contains 1 or more of your structures, to a maximum of 3 hits.

name: Skaði's Bow II
text:
This unit is treated as both a structure and a ground force. It cannot be transported.
You may use this unit's SPACE CANNON against ships in systems adjacent to this unit's system.
Combat 6 (x2), PLANETARY SHIELD, SPACE CANNON 5

name: Hearthcall Beacon
text: After you activate a system that contains 1 or more of your units, apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.

name: Roar of the Gjallarhorn
text: Before you would roll for your unit's BOMBARDMENT, you may exhaust this card. Planets in the active system lose PLANETARY SHIELD until the end of this tactical action.

name: Yggdrasil's Sacrifice
text: ACTION: Remove 1 root token from a planet to ready that planet.

name: Yggdrasil's Wrath
text: When another player's unit uses BOMBARDMENT against 1 of your planets that contains a root token, roll 1 die for each hit produced. For each result of 5 or higher, assign that hit to 1 of that player's units in that system instead.

name: Compose An Edda
text: After you win a combat in a system that contains a legendary planet, gain 2 trade goods and 1 command token.

name: Sleipnir's Steeds II
text:
This unit may move without being transported. Fighters in excess of your ships' capacity count against your fleet pool. This unit cannot transport other fighters.
Cost 1 (x2), Combat 8, Move 2, Capacity 1
